title: The Informational Role of Emission Markets: Prices vs Quantities with Dispersed Information About Externalities
abstract: I study asymmetric information about the social cost of an externality, as opposed to asymmetric information about private costs of abatement. I show that quantity regulation with bankable permits has an informational advantage because the permit market aggregates dispersed information about social costs. It has the disadvantage of making private costs more uncertain ex ante. I analytically derive the expression for the (dis)advantage of prices over quantities in this setting. I show that a quantity policy can dominate a price policy for any slope of marginal private costs and always dominates when marginal private costs are sufficiently flat.
abstract_zh: 我研究的是关于外部性社会成本的不对称信息，而非关于减排私人成本的不对称信息。我表明，可储存许可证的数量规制具有信息优势，因为许可证市场汇集了关于社会成本的分散信息。其劣势在于，事前会使私人成本更加不确定。我在这一设定中解析地推导出价格相对于数量的（优劣）表达式。我表明，当边际私人成本的斜率为任意值时，数量政策都可能优于价格政策，而当边际私人成本足够平坦时，数量政策总是占优。

title: Weather Forecasts Become More Important for Reducing Mortality as the Climate Warms
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Climate change will increase the frequency and severity of extreme heat, which is a leading cause of weather-related mortality. We combine causal estimates of how temperature forecast accuracy affects mortality in the United States with expert projections of changes in forecast accuracy over the coming century. Our analysis shows that improving short-run temperature forecasts in line with central expert projections would reduce annual heat-related mortality by about 18% by 2100, saving thousands of lives per year. If investments in earth observation networks and weather models improve forecasts in line with optimistic expert projections, annual heat-related mortality would fall by around 25% by 2100. Improving forecasts facilitates adaptation to climate change, saving more lives when climate change is more severe.
abstract_zh: 气候变化将增加极端高温的频率与强度，而极端高温是与天气相关死亡的主要原因之一。我们将美国温度预报准确性如何影响死亡率的因果估计，与专家对未来一个世纪预报准确性变化的预测相结合。分析表明，若短期温度预报的改进符合专家的中位预测，到2100年每年与高温相关的死亡人数将减少约18%，每年可挽救数千条生命。若对地球观测网络和天气模型的投资使预报改进达到乐观专家预测的水平，到2100年每年与高温相关的死亡人数将减少约25%。改进预报有助于适应气候变化，且气候变化越严重，挽救的生命也越多。

title: Navigating the "Problem from Hell": A Guide to Climate Damages
abstract: Multiple lines of research aim to quantify the economic impacts of climate change. We show that the effects of climate change on economic activity depend on how climate change alters weather across time and space. Changes in contemporary weather have direct effects on output; changes in past weather and in expectations of future weather induce adaptation; and changes in weather elsewhere around the globe introduce a general equilibrium effect. Using this framework, we argue that estimation of climate impacts faces a trilemma. A methodology can have at most two of: (i) robustness to a particular economic model’s structure, (ii) interpretation as effects of persistent, widespread, anticipated climate change, and (iii) quasi-experimental identification. We summarize the literature on climate damages in light of the trilemma. A solid body of knowledge has developed around direct effects, and recent work has made substantial progress towards understanding adaptation and spatial spillovers. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 多条研究路线旨在量化气候变化的经济影响。我们表明，气候变化对经济活动的影响取决于其如何在时间和空间上改变天气。当前天气的变化对产出有直接影响；过去天气的变化以及对未来天气的预期会引发适应行为；全球其他地区天气的变化则带来一般均衡效应。基于这一框架，我们认为气候影响的估计面临一个三难困境：一种方法至多只能同时满足以下三项中的两项：(i) 对特定经济模型结构的稳健性，(ii) 可解释为持续、广泛且可预期的气候变化的效应，以及(iii) 准实验识别。我们依据这一三难困境梳理了气候损害的文献。围绕直接效应已形成扎实的知识体系，近期研究在理解适应行为与空间溢出效应方面也取得了实质进展。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅用户以及发展中国家的居民，可在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Estimating the Consequences of Climate Change from Variation in Weather
abstract: I formally relate the consequences of climate change to the panel variation in weather extensively explored by recent empirical literature.I show that short-run responses to weather shocks differ from long-run responses to climate change when payoffs depend on a capital or resource stock.I develop a new indirect least squares estimator that bounds long-run climate impacts from shortrun responses to weather. Applying this new method, I find that an additional 2°C of global warming would eliminate profits from the average acre of current farmland in the eastern U.S.
abstract_zh: 我正式地将气候变化的后果与近期实证文献中广泛探讨的天气面板变异联系起来。我表明，当收益依赖于资本或资源存量时，对天气冲击的短期反应与对气候变化的长期反应有所不同。我开发了一种新的间接最小二乘估计量，可利用短期天气反应为长期气候影响设定界限。应用这一新方法，我发现，全球变暖每增加2°C，将使美国东部当前农田中每英亩平均的利润消失。

title: Big Beautiful Numbers: The Impact of Governmental Data on Firms' Valuations
Climbing the Energy Ladder: How Energy Resources Hinder, Facilitate, and Fuel Economic Growth
abstract: I show that the nature of the energy resources available to an economy qualitatively determines long-run growth outcomes.A harvested resource such as biomass drags on growth, a mined resource such as coal enables output per capita to hold constant, and both a tapped resource such as oil and a manufactured resource such as solar panels risk degrowth if energy return on energy invested (EROI) cannot stay above a threshold. The only energy resource that can fuel long-run growth is a manufactured resource such as solar panels. Either that resource must rely on substitutable energy inputs that have a sufficiently large EROI, or it must be produced by robots that are themselves produced from robots and energy. Even in these cases, coal and oil economies may have been necessary stages on the way from a biomass economy to a solar economy.
abstract_zh: 我证明，一个经济体可获得的能源资源的性质，从质上决定了其长期增长结果。收获型资源（如生物质）会拖累增长；开采型资源（如煤炭）能够使人均产出保持不变；而抽取型资源（如石油）和制造型资源（如太阳能板）则存在退化增长的风险，除非其能源投资回报率（EROI）能够维持在某一阈值之上。唯一能够支撑长期增长的能源资源是制造型资源，例如太阳能板。该资源要么必须依赖可替代的能源投入，且其EROI足够高，要么必须由机器人生产，而这些机器人本身又由机器人和能源生产。即便在这些情形下，煤炭经济和石油经济也可能是从生物质经济迈向太阳能经济途中所必需的阶段。

title: Equity and Efficiency in International Climate Adaptation Portfolios
Teleconnected Summer Weather Extremes Alter Trade Around the World
What Were the Odds? Estimating the Market's Probability of Uncertain Events
Climate change has already made the United States poorer
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: The climate is already changing. The present study shows that these changes have already affected the U.S. economy. It develops a formal framework that accounts for how climate change has affected each county’s economy by altering current and past weather, both locally and elsewhere around the country. The results show that climate change is already reducing annual U.S. income by 0.32% [95% CI: −0.17 to 0.82%] by altering counties’ current, local temperatures, with losses concentrated in the Great Plains and Midwest. Accounting for effects on past temperatures and on temperatures in other counties increases income losses to 12% [2.0 to 22%] and makes them more widely distributed, with suggestive evidence that trade networks propagate effects around the United States. Central estimates can change with different indices of nonlocal weather or models of cross-county heterogeneity. Calculations like those developed here could be updated annually as a way of measuring and communicating the progress of climate change.
abstract_zh: 气候正在发生变化。本研究表明，这些变化已经对美国经济产生了影响。我构建了一个正式的分析框架，用以刻画气候变化如何通过改变各县当前及过去的天气状况（既包括本地，也包括全国其他地区）而影响该县的经济。结果显示，气候变化已通过改变各县当前的本地气温，使美国年收入减少0.32%（95%置信区间：−0.17%至0.82%），损失主要集中在大平原地区和中西部。若将过去气温的影响以及其他县气温的影响纳入考虑，收入损失将上升至12%（2.0%至22%），且损失分布更为广泛；有迹象表明，贸易网络会将影响在美国各地传播。核心估计值可能因非本地天气指数的不同选择或跨县异质性模型的不同设定而改变。本文所发展的此类测算方法可每年更新，作为衡量和传达气候变化进展的一种方式。

title: Equity and efficiency in the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law's adaptation investments
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy

title: PFAS-contaminated drinking water harms infants
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: There is evidence of widespread human exposure to per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) but limited evidence of the human health impacts of this exposure. Using data on New Hampshire births from 2010–2019, we show that mothers receiving water that had flowed beneath a PFAS-contaminated site, as opposed to comparable mothers receiving water that had flowed toward a PFAS-contaminated site, had 191% [95% CI: 83–298%] higher first-year infant mortality (611 [268–955] additional first-year deaths per 100k births); 168% [42–294%] more births before 28 wk of gestational age (466 [116–817] additional such births per 100k births); and 180% [57–302%] more births with weight below 1,000 g (607 [192–1022] additional such births per 100k births). Extrapolating to the contiguous U.S., PFAS contamination imposes annual social costs of approximately $8 billion. These health costs are substantially larger than current outside estimates of the cost of removing PFAS from the public water supply.
abstract_zh: 有证据表明，全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）已在人群中广泛暴露，但关于这种暴露对人体健康影响的证据却很有限。利用新罕布什尔州2010至2019年的出生数据，我们发现：与饮用流向PFAS污染场地的水的可比母亲相比，饮用曾流经PFAS污染场地下方的水的母亲，其婴儿第一年死亡率高出191%［95%置信区间：83%–298%］（每10万例出生中额外增加611［268–955］例第一年死亡）；妊娠28周前早产的情况增加168%［42%–294%］（每10万例出生中额外增加466［116–817］例此类早产）；出生体重低于1000克的情况增加180%［57%–302%］（每10万例出生中额外增加607［192–1022］例此类低体重出生）。将结果推广到美国大陆，PFAS污染每年造成的社会成本约为80亿美元。这些健康成本大大高于目前外部机构估计的从公共供水中去除PFAS的成本。

title: Rationally misplaced confidence
Financial markets value skillful forecasts of seasonal climate
abstract: Scientific agencies spend substantial sums producing and improving forecasts of seasonal climate, but they do so without much information about these forecasts’ value in practice. Here we show that financial market participants value the production of seasonal forecasts: options traders price the uncertainty generated by upcoming United States National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration Winter and El Niño Outlooks. Each outlook affects firms throughout the economy, with total market capitalization of $6 and $13 trillion, respectively. A 1% improvement in the skill of the El Niño Outlook reduces firms’ exposure to a one standard deviation shock by $18 billion and induces traders to spend an additional $2 million hedging the outlook’s news. Firms must not be able to undertake ex-ante adaptation that would eliminate their exposure to the forecasted portion of seasonal climate without imposing substantial costs of its own.
abstract_zh: 科研机构在制作和改进季节性气候预报方面投入了大量资金，但对这些预报在实践中的价值却知之甚少。本文表明，金融市场参与者重视季节性预报的产出：期权交易者会为美国国家海洋和大气管理局即将发布的冬季展望和厄尔尼诺展望所带来的不确定性定价。这两项展望分别影响整个经济中的企业，其总市值分别为6万亿美元和13万亿美元。厄尔尼诺展望预报技能每提高1%，企业对一个标准差冲击的风险敞口就减少180亿美元，并促使交易者额外花费200万美元对冲该展望所传递的信息。若企业不能在事前采取适应措施，且这些措施本身不会带来高昂成本，那么它们就无法消除其对季节性气候中被预报部分的风险敞口。

title: Innovation-led transitions in energy supply
abstract: Generalizing models of directed technical change, I show that complementarities between innovations and factors of production (here, energy resources) can drive transitions away from a dominant sector. In a calibrated numerical implementation, the economy gradually transitions energy supply from coal to gas and then to renewable energy, even in the absence of policy. The welfare-maximizing tax on carbon emissions is J-shaped, immediately redirects most research to renewables, and rapidly transitions energy supply directly to renewables. The emission tax is twice as valuable as either the welfare-maximizing research subsidy or the welfare-maximizing mandate to use renewable resources. (JEL H23, O31, O33, Q35, Q41, Q54)
abstract_zh: 通过推广有向技术变迁模型，我证明创新与生产要素（此处指能源资源）之间的互补性可以推动经济逐步脱离原有的主导部门。在一个经过校准的数值模拟中，即使没有政策干预，经济的能源供给也会逐步从煤炭转向天然气，再转向可再生能源。福利最大化的碳排放税呈J形，能够立即将大部分研发引向可再生能源，并迅速使能源供给直接转向可再生能源。排放税的价值是福利最大化的研发补贴或福利最大化的可再生资源使用强制性规定的两倍。（JEL H23, O31, O33, Q35, Q41, Q54）

title: Informationally Efficient Climate Policy: Designing Markets to Measure and Price Externalities
abstract: I study how policymakers can access and act on the information about climate change damages that is dispersed throughout the economy. I analyze a new dynamic deposit-refund instrument that I label “carbon shares”. This instrument empowers markets to perform price discovery about future damages. I show that there exists a limit-case rational expectations equilibrium in which this instrument: i) efficiently prices new emissions, ii) efficiently incentivizes removal of past emissions, and iii) efficiently aggregates dispersed information about the social cost of emissions. Conventional emission taxes achieve only the first of these objectives, for given information. Calibrated numerical simulations suggest benefits from achieving the other two objectives.
abstract_zh: 本文研究政策制定者如何获取并运用分散于整个经济体中的气候变化损害信息。我分析了一种新的动态押金退还工具，并将其命名为“碳份额”。该工具使市场能够对未来的损害进行价格发现。我证明，存在一种极限情形下的理性预期均衡，在该均衡中，这一工具能够：i）有效地为新增排放定价；ii）有效地激励清除过去的排放；iii）有效地汇总分散的关于排放社会成本的信息。在给定信息的条件下，传统的排放税只能实现第一个目标。经过校准的数值模拟表明，实现另外两个目标同样能够带来收益。

title: Fatal Errors: The Mortality Value of Accurate Weather Forecasts
abstract: We provide the first revealed preference estimates of the benefits of routine weather forecasts. The benefits come from how people use advance information to reduce mortality from heat and cold. Theoretically, more accurate forecasts reduce mortality if and only if mortality risk is convex in forecast errors. We test for such convexity using data on the universe of mortality events and weather forecasts for a twelve-year period in the U.S. Results show that erroneously mild forecasts increase mortality whereas erroneously extreme forecasts do not reduce mortality. Making forecasts 50% more accurate would save 2,200 lives per year. The public would be willing to pay $112 billion to make forecasts 50% more accurate over the remainder of the century, of which $22 billion reflects how forecasts facilitate adaptation to climate change.
abstract_zh: 我们首次给出了日常天气预报收益的显示偏好估计。这些收益源于人们如何利用事先信息来减少高温与低温导致的死亡。理论上，当且仅当死亡风险是预报误差的凸函数时，更准确的预报才能减少死亡。我们利用美国十二年间全部死亡事件与天气预报的数据检验了这种凸性。结果显示，错误地预报偏温和会增加死亡，而错误地预报偏极端则不会减少死亡。将预报准确性提高50%每年可挽救2,200条生命。公众愿意为在本世纪剩余时间内将预报准确性提高50%支付1,120亿美元，其中220亿美元反映的是预报对适应气候变化的促进作用。

title: Designing dynamic subsidies to spur adoption of new technologies
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

title: The climate risk premium: How uncertainty affects the social cost of carbon
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: I analyze the marginal value of reducing greenhouse gas emissions (the "social cost of carbon") under uncertainty about warming, under uncertainty about how much warming reduces consumption, and under stochastic shocks to consumption growth. I theoretically demonstrate that each of these sources of uncertainty increases the social cost of carbon under conventional preferences. In a calibrated numerical implementation, uncertainty increases the 200-year social cost of carbon by more than 20%. Uncertainty about the consumption impacts of warming contributes the most to this premium and makes the social cost of carbon sensitive to impacts even after 2400.
abstract_zh: 本文分析在三类不确定性下减少温室气体排放的边际价值（即“碳的社会成本”）：气候变暖本身的不确定性、变暖对消费造成损害程度的不确定性，以及消费增长中的随机冲击。理论分析表明，在传统偏好下，上述每一种不确定性来源都会提高碳的社会成本。在一个经过校准的数值模拟中，不确定性使200年期碳的社会成本提高了20%以上。变暖对消费影响的不确定性对这一风险溢价的贡献最大，并使碳的社会成本即使在2400年之后仍对影响程度保持敏感。

title: General equilibrium rebound from energy efficiency innovation
abstract: Energy efficiency improvements "rebound" when economic responses undercut their direct energy savings.I show that general equilibrium channels typically amplify rebound by making consumption goods cheaper but typically dampen rebound by increasing demand for non-energy inputs to production and by changing the size of the energy supply sector. Improvements in the efficiency of the energy supply sector generate especially large rebound because they make energy cheaper in all other sectors. Quantitatively, improving the efficiency of U.S. non-energy supply sectors by 1% would reduce U.S. energy use by 0.58%, with rebound of 28%.General equilibrium channels increase those savings by 19%; however, they reduce the savings from improving the efficiency of the energy supply sector by 65%.
abstract_zh: 当经济层面的反应削弱了能效提升的直接节能效果时，就会出现能源效率改进的“回弹效应”。本文表明，一般均衡渠道通常会因使消费品变得更便宜而放大回弹效应，但也常因增加对非能源生产投入的需求以及改变能源供应部门的规模而抑制回弹效应。能源供应部门的效率提升会产生特别大的回弹效应，因为它使所有其他部门的能源变得更便宜。从数量上看，将美国非能源供应部门的效率提高1%，将使美国能源使用量减少0.58%，回弹率为28%。一般均衡渠道会使这些节能量增加19%；然而，它们会使提升能源供应部门效率所带来的节能量减少65%。

title: Age-induced acceleration of time: Implications for intertemporal choice
venue: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization

title: Escape from third-best: Rating emissions for intensity standards
Green expectations: Current effects of anticipated carbon pricing
Managing climate change under uncertainty: Recursive integrated assessment at an inflection point
abstract: Uncertainty is critical to questions about climate change policy. Recently developed recursive integrated assessment models have become the primary tools for studying and quantifying the policy implications of uncertainty. We decompose the channels through which uncertainty affects policy and quantify them in a recursive extension of a benchmark integrated assessment model. The first wave of recursive models has made valuable, pioneering efforts at analyzing disparate sources of uncertainty. We argue that frontier numerical methods will enable the next generation of recursive models to better capture the information structure of climate change and to thereby ask new types of questions about climate change policy.
abstract_zh: 不确定性是气候变化政策问题的关键所在。近期发展起来的递归综合评估模型已成为研究和量化不确定性所带来的政策影响的主要工具。我们分解了不确定性影响政策的各条渠道，并在一个基准综合评估模型的递归扩展中对其进行量化。第一代递归模型在分析各类不同的不确定性来源方面作出了宝贵的开创性努力。我们认为，前沿的数值方法将使下一代递归模型能够更好地刻画气候变化的信息结构，从而提出关于气候变化政策的新类型问题。

title: Steering the climate system: Using inertia to lower the cost of policy
abstract: Common views hold that the efficient way to limit warming to a chosen level is to price carbon emissions at a rate that increases exponentially. We show that this Hotelling tax on carbon emissions is actually inefficient. The least-cost policy path takes advantage of the climate system's inertia to delay reducing emissions and allow greater cumulative emissions. The efficient carbon tax follows an inverse-U-shaped path and grows more slowly than the Hotelling tax. Economic models that assume exponentially increasing carbon taxes are overestimating the cost of limiting warming, overestimating the efficient near-term carbon tax, and overvaluing technologies that mature sooner. (JEL H23, Q54, Q58)
abstract_zh: 一种普遍观点认为，将变暖控制在既定水平之内的有效方式，是按指数增长的速率为碳排放定价。我们证明，这种霍特林碳税实际上是低效的。成本最小的政策路径利用气候系统的惯性来推迟减排，从而允许更多的累计排放。有效的碳税呈倒U形路径，且增长速度慢于霍特林碳税。假定碳税呈指数增长的经济模型高估了将变暖控制在一定水平的成本，高估了有效的近期碳税水平，并高估了较早成熟技术的价值。（JEL H23, Q54, Q58）

title: A top-down approach to projecting market impacts of climate change
Ambiguous tipping points
venue: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization

title: Economics of tipping the climate dominoes
Watch your step: Optimal policy in a tipping climate
abstract: We investigate the optimal policy response to the possibility of abrupt, irreversible shifts in system dynamics. The welfare cost of a tipping point emerges from the policymaker's response to altered system dynamics. Our policymaker also learns about a threshold's location by observing the system's response in each period. Simulations with a recursive, numerical climate-economy model show that tipping possibilities raise the optimal carbon tax more strongly over time. The resulting policy paths ultimately lower optimal peak warming by up to 0.5°C. Different types of posttipping shifts in dynamics generate qualitatively different optimal pretipping policy paths. (JEL D78, H23, Q54, Q58)
abstract_zh: 我们研究政策制定者面对系统动力学可能发生突然且不可逆转转变时的最优政策应对。临界点的福利成本来自政策制定者对系统动力学变化的反应。我们的政策制定者还会通过观察每一期系统的反应来了解阈值的位置。基于递归数值气候-经济模型的模拟表明，临界可能性会随时间推移更强烈地推高最优碳税。由此得出的政策路径最终可将最优峰值变暖幅度降低多达0.5°C。临界点之后动力学的不同类型转变，会在临界点之前产生性质不同的最优政策路径。（JEL D78, H23, Q54, Q58）

title: The economics of solar electricity
abstract: The benefits and costs of increasing solar electricity generation depend on the scale of the increase and on the time frame over which it occurs. Short-run analyses focus on the cost-effectiveness of incremental increases in solar capacity, holding the rest of the power system fixed. Solar’s variability adds value if its power occurs at high-demand times and displaces relatively carbon-intensive generation. Medium-run analyses consider the implications of nonincremental changes in solar capacity. The cost of each installation may fall through experience effects, but the cost of grid integration increases when solar requires ancillary services and fails to displace investment in other types of generation. Long-run analyses consider the role of solar in reaching twenty-first-century carbon targets. Solar’s contribution depends on the representation of grid integration costs, on the availability of other low-carbon technologies, and on the potential for technological advances. By surveying analyses for different time horizons, this article begins to connect and integrate a fairly disjointed literature on the economics of solar energy.
abstract_zh: 增加太阳能发电的收益和成本取决于增长的规模以及增长所发生的时间框架。短期分析关注的是在保持电力系统其他部分不变的情况下，增量式增加太阳能装机容量的成本效益。若太阳能发电的波动性恰好出现在用电高峰时段，并替代了碳排放强度相对较高的发电方式，则其波动性会增加价值。中期分析考虑太阳能装机容量非增量式变化的影响。通过经验效应，每套装置的成本可能会下降，但当太阳能需要辅助服务且未能替代其他类型发电投资时，电网整合的成本会上升。长期分析考虑太阳能在实现二十一世纪碳排放目标中的作用。太阳能的贡献取决于对电网整合成本的刻画、其他低碳技术的可获得性以及技术进步的潜力。本文通过梳理不同时间跨度的分析，尝试将关于太阳能经济学的一批较为零散的文献加以联系和整合。

title: Trapped between two tails: Trading off scientific uncertainties via climate targets
abstract: Climate change policies must trade off uncertainties about future warming, about the social and ecological impacts of warming, and about the cost of reducing greenhouse gas emissions. We show that laxer carbon targets produce broader distributions for climate damages, skewed towards severe outcomes. However, if potential low-carbon technologies fill overlapping niches, then more stringent carbon targets produce broader distributions for the cost of reducing emissions, skewed towards high-cost outcomes. We use the technology-rich GCAM integrated assessment model to assess the robustness of 450 and 500 ppm carbon targets to each uncertain factor. The 500 ppm target provides net benefits across a broad range of futures. The 450 ppm target provides net benefits only when impacts are greater than conventionally assumed, when multiple technological breakthroughs lower the cost of abatement, or when evaluated with a low discount rate. Policy evaluations are more sensitive to uncertainty about abatement technology and impacts than to uncertainty about warming.
abstract_zh: 气候变化政策必须在以下几方面的不确定性之间进行权衡：未来的变暖程度、变暖的社会和生态影响，以及减少温室气体排放的成本。我们证明，较宽松的碳排放目标会使气候损害的分布更加分散，并偏向严重后果一侧。然而，如果潜在的低碳技术占据相互重叠的生态位，那么更严格的碳排放目标会使减排成本的分布更加分散，并偏向高成本一侧。我们利用技术细节丰富的GCAM综合评估模型，检验450 ppm和500 ppm碳排放目标在每个不确定因素面前的稳健性。500 ppm目标在广泛的未来情景中都能带来净收益。450 ppm目标仅在以下情况下才能带来净收益：影响大于传统假设的水平、多项技术突破降低了减排成本，或采用较低贴现率进行评估。相较于变暖程度的不确定性，政策评估对减排技术和影响的不确定性更为敏感。

title: The influence of negative emission technologies and technology policies on the optimal climate mitigation portfolio
abstract: Combining policies to remove carbon dioxide (CO2) from the atmosphere with policies to reduce emissions could decrease CO2 concentrations faster than possible via natural processes. We model the optimal selection of a dynamic portfolio of abatement, research and development (R&D), and negative emission policies under an exogenous CO2 constraint and with stochastic technological change. We find that near-term abatement is not sensitive to the availability of R&D policies, but the anticipated availability of negative emission strategies can reduce the near-term abatement optimally undertaken to meet 2 degrees C temperature limits. Further, planning to deploy negative emission technologies shifts optimal R&D funding from "carbon-free" technologies into "emission intensity" technologies. Making negative emission strategies available enables an 80% reduction in the cost of keeping year 2100 CO2 concentrations near their current level. However, negative emission strategies are less important if the possibility of tipping points rules out using late-century net negative emissions to temporarily overshoot the CO2 constraint earlier in the century.
abstract_zh: 将从大气中清除二氧化碳（CO2）的政策与减排政策相结合，可能使CO2浓度的下降速度快于自然过程所能实现的速度。我们在外生的CO2约束条件下，并考虑随机技术变迁，对减排、研发（R&D）和负排放政策的动态组合进行了最优选择建模。我们发现，近期的减排力度对研发政策的可获得性并不敏感，但对负排放策略的预期可获得性，会减少为达到2摄氏度温控目标而在近期最优实施的减排量。此外，计划部署负排放技术，会使最优研发资金从“无碳”技术转向“排放强度”技术。使负排放策略可获得，能使将2100年CO2浓度维持在当前水平所需的成本降低80%。然而，如果技术临界点的可能性排除了利用本世纪末的净负排放在本世纪早期暂时超出CO2约束的做法，那么负排放策略的重要性就会降低。

title: Reduce growth rate of light-duty vehicle travel to meet 2050 global climate goals
abstract: Strong policies to constrain increasing global use of light-duty vehicles (cars and light trucks) should complement fuel efficiency and carbon intensity improvements in order to meet international greenhouse gas emission and climate targets for the year 2050.
abstract_zh: 为实现2050年国际温室气体减排和气候目标，应当在燃油效率和碳强度改善的同时，实施强有力的政策，以遏制全球轻型车辆（轿车和轻型卡车）使用量的持续增长。

title: Climate sensitivity distributions depend on the possibility that models share biases
Paleoclimatic warming increased carbon dioxide concentrations
abstract: If climate‐carbon feedbacks are positive, then warming causes changes in carbon dioxide (CO2) sources and sinks that increase CO2 concentrations and create further warming. Previous work using paleoclimatic reconstructions has not disentangled the causal effect of interest from the effects of reverse causality and autocorrelation. The response of CO2 to variations in orbital forcing over the past 800,000 years suggests that millennial‐scale climate‐carbon feedbacks are significantly positive and significantly greater than century‐scale feedbacks. Feedbacks are also significantly greater on 100 year time scales than on 50 year time scales over the past 1500 years. Posterior probability distributions implied by coupled models' predictions and by these paleoclimatic results give a mean of 0.03 for the nondimensional climate‐carbon feedback factor and a 90% chance of its being between −0.04 and 0.09. The 70% chance that climate‐carbon feedbacks are positive implies that temperature change projections tend to underestimate an emission path's consequences if they do not allow the carbon cycle to respond to changing temperatures.
abstract_zh: 如果气候-碳反馈为正，那么变暖将引起二氧化碳（CO2）源和汇的变化，从而提高CO2浓度，并造成进一步的变暖。以往利用古气候重建数据的研究，尚未能将所关心的因果效应与反向因果和自相关的影响区分开来。过去80万年间，CO2对轨道强迫变化的响应表明，千年尺度的气候-碳反馈显著为正，且显著大于百年尺度的反馈。在过去1500年中，百年时间尺度上的反馈也显著大于五十年时间尺度上的反馈。根据耦合模式的预测以及这些古气候结果得出的后验概率分布显示，无量纲气候-碳反馈因子的均值为0.03，其90%的置信区间为−0.04至0.09。气候-碳反馈为正的概率为70%，这意味着，如果温度变化预测不允许碳循环对不断变化的温度作出响应，那么它们往往会低估某一排放路径的后果。

title: The climate impacts of bioenergy systems depend on market and regulatory policy contexts
abstract: Biomass can help reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions by displacing petroleum in the transportation sector, by displacing fossil-based electricity, and by sequestering atmospheric carbon. Which use mitigates the most emissions depends on market and regulatory contexts outside the scope of attributional life cycle assessments. We show that bioelectricity's advantage over liquid biofuels depends on the GHG intensity of the electricity displaced. Bioelectricity that displaces coal-fired electricity could reduce GHG emissions, but bioelectricity that displaces wind electricity could increase GHG emissions. The electricity displaced depends upon existing infrastructure and policies affecting the electric grid. These findings demonstrate how model assumptions about whether the vehicle fleet and bioenergy use are fixed or free parameters constrain the policy questions an analysis can inform. Our bioenergy life cycle assessment can inform questions about a bioenergy mandate's optimal allocation between liquid fuels and electricity generation, but questions about the optimal level of bioenergy use require analyses with different assumptions about fixed and free parameters.
abstract_zh: 生物质能可以通过替代交通部门的石油、替代化石燃料发电以及固定大气碳，来帮助减少温室气体（GHG）排放。哪种利用方式减排效果最好，取决于市场和监管环境，而这些环境超出了归因型生命周期评估的范围。我们表明，生物电相对于液体生物燃料的优势取决于所替代电力的温室气体排放强度。替代燃煤发电的生物电可能减少温室气体排放，但替代风电的生物电则可能增加温室气体排放。被替代的电力取决于现有基础设施以及影响电网的政策。这些发现表明，关于车辆保有量和生物能源使用量是固定参数还是自由参数的模型假设，如何制约一项分析所能回答的政策问题。我们的生物能源生命周期评估可以为生物能源强制性规定在液体燃料与发电之间的最优分配提供参考，但关于生物能源最优使用水平的问题，则需要基于不同的固定与自由参数假设进行分析。

title: Valuing plug-in hybrid electric vehicles' battery capacity using a real options framework
Addendum to "An innovation and policy agenda for commercially competitive plug-in hybrid electric vehicles
abstract: Plug-in hybrid electric vehicles (PHEVs) can use both grid-supplied electricity and liquid fuels. We show that under recent conditions, millions of PHEVs could have charged economically in California during both peak and off-peak hours even with modest gasoline prices and real-time electricity pricing. Special electricity rate tariffs already in place for electric vehicles could successfully render on-peak charging uneconomical and off-peak charging very attractive. However, unless battery prices fall by at least a factor of two, or gasoline prices double, the present value of fuel savings is smaller than the marginal vehicle costs, likely slowing PHEV market penetration in California. We also find that assumptions about how PHEVs are charged strongly influence the number of PHEVs that can be charged before the electric power system must be expanded. If most PHEVs are charged after the workday, and thus after the time of peak electricity demand, our forecasts suggest that several million PHEVs could be deployed in California without requiring new generation capacity, and we also find that the state's PHEV fleet is unlikely to reach into the millions within the current electricity sector planning cycle. To ensure desirable outcomes, appropriate technologies and incentives for PHEV charging will be needed if PHEV adoption becomes mainstream.
abstract_zh: 插电式混合动力汽车（PHEV）既可以使用电网供应的电力，也可以使用液体燃料。我们表明，在近期条件下，即使汽油价格适中且采用实时电价，加州也有数百万辆PHEV可以经济地在用电高峰和低谷时段充电。目前针对电动汽车已实施的特殊电价优惠政策，可能使高峰时段充电变得不经济，而低谷时段充电则极具吸引力。然而，除非电池价格至少下降一半，或汽油价格翻倍，否则燃油节省的现值仍小于车辆的边际成本，这可能会减缓PHEV在加州的市场渗透。我们还发现，关于PHEV充电方式的假设，会强烈影响在必须扩建电力系统之前能够充电的PHEV数量。如果大多数PHEV在下班后充电，从而避开用电高峰时段，我们的预测表明，加州可以在无需新增发电容量的情况下部署数百万辆PHEV；同时，我们还发现，在当前电力行业规划周期内，该州的PHEV保有量不太可能达到数百万辆。为实现理想结果，若PHEV普及成为主流，则需要相应的技术和充电激励措施。

title: Cost-effectiveness of greenhouse gas emission reductions from plug-in hybrid electric vehicles
abstract: We find that plug-in hybrid electric vehicles (PHEVs) could significantly reduce automotive greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and petroleum consumption, while improving energy security and urban air quality. Widespread PHEV adoption will depend upon technological and economic advances in batteries because the initial fuel savings do not rapidly compensate consumers for the capital costs of batteries today. For PHEV purchases to become economical to consumers, battery prices must decline from $1,300 per kilowatt-hour (kWh) to about or below $500/kWh, or U.S. gasoline prices must remain at about $5 per gallon-or the federal government must institute policy innovations with equivalent effects, such as policies to lower battery cost and increase battery lifetimes (e.g. a broad and sustained program of battery RD&D), or those to widen the difference between gasoline and electricity prices (e.g. changes in energy taxes). However, even before PHEVs become cost-effective consumers, their purchase can still be highly valuable to society if their significant GHG reductions can be achieved cost-effectively (using a benchmark price of about $50/t-CO2-eq). Using the GREET model, we determine that in order for PHEVs' reductions to become cost-effective, either their purchase must approach current unsubsidized prices-requiring the same policy innovations described above-or very low-GHG electricity must be used to power them. This requires policies to decrease the GHG intensity of electricity, such as renewable portfolio standards, feed-in tariffs or other measures. Importantly, we find that any carbon price would have to exceed $100/t-CO2-eq in order to render PHEVs' reductions cost-effective, and hence a carbon price alone represents an impractical short-term means of achieving this goal.
abstract_zh: 我们发现，插电式混合动力汽车（PHEV）可以显著减少汽车领域的温室气体（GHG）排放和石油消费，同时提高能源安全并改善城市空气质量。PHEV的广泛普及将取决于电池技术和经济方面的进步，因为目前的初始燃油节省不足以迅速补偿消费者的电池资本成本。要使PHEV购买对消费者而言变得经济，电池价格必须从每千瓦时1300美元降至约500美元或以下，或者美国汽油价格必须维持在每加仑约5美元左右，或者联邦政府必须推出具有同等效果的政策创新，例如降低电池成本并延长电池寿命的政策（如广泛且持续的电池研发、示范和推广计划），或扩大汽油与电力价格差距的政策（如能源税的调整）。然而，即使在PHEV对消费者具有成本效益之前，只要其显著的温室气体减排能够以具有成本效益的方式实现（以每吨二氧化碳当量约50美元的基准价格计），其购买对社会仍可能极具价值。利用GREET模型，我们确定，要使PHEV的减排具有成本效益，要么其购买价格必须接近当前未补贴价格（这需要上述政策创新），要么必须使用温室气体排放极低的电力为其充电。这就需要通过可再生能源配额制、上网电价或其他措施来降低电力的温室气体排放强度。重要的是，我们发现，任何碳价格都必须超过每吨二氧化碳当量100美元，才能使PHEV的减排具有成本效益，因此仅靠碳价格是一种不切实际的短期实现途径。

title: A landscape-level GIS analysis of streamside management zones on the Cumberland Plateau
